assets.title: Sophia walking and waving
assets.provenance: Both source GLBs supplied by Amy; Sophia's original geometry, rig, walking and waving clips retained. Only embedded textures resized/re-encoded. No generated animation or replacement appearance added.
assets.modifications: Combined the compatible supplied walking and waving clips with one mesh and optimized texture. Runtime normalizes height/orientation and removes horizontal root travel from clip copies.

assets.title: Cora walking and waving
assets.provenance: Walking and waving GLBs supplied by Amy on 2026-09-20 for the landing page and companion. No third-party creator or license is inferred.
assets.modifications: Combined compatible authored clips with a single mesh, skeleton and optimized texture. Original non-image buffers and animation sample bytes verified unchanged. Runtime normalizes height/orientation and removes horizontal root travel from clip copies.

assets.name: Vintage safari Land Cruiser with roof rack
assets.generationMethod: Meshy Image-to-3D, meshy-7.1 standard geometry and textures
assets.modifications: Embedded textures resized to 1024px. Every non-image buffer verified byte-identical.
assets.provenance: Created at Amy's request. OpenAI-generated FJ40 reference supplied to Meshy Image-to-3D. No third-party mesh was copied.
assets.reviewStatus: Reference and four cardinal renders visually inspected. Static vehicle used for instant travel between story stops.

assets.title: Nine animal models, including three image-guided revisions
assets.provenance: Initial nine text-generated models cost 135 credits. Lion, ostrich and hippo were replaced with reviewed OpenAI image references through Meshy Image-to-3D for 90 additional credits. Per-model source and output hashes and task IDs are retained in generation receipts.
assets.reviewStatus: Seven species including the supplied zebra are in the story safari. The three image-guided animal revisions are in the gallery. Reference images and four cardinal renders of each revision were visually inspected; all animal models remain static.

assets.title: Soph walking character
assets.provenance: Supplied by Amy on 2026-09-20 for use as the playable explorer. Export metadata identifies Blender; no creator or license metadata is embedded, so no third-party authorship or license is inferred.
assets.modifications: Opaque 2048px PNG resized to 1024px JPEG; geometry, skin and animation buffers preserved. Runtime normalizes height/orientation and makes a copy of the walk clip with horizontal root travel removed so collision controls own movement.
assets.reviewStatus: User-supplied prototype character with embedded walk. License metadata not supplied; provenance recorded without an inferred license.

assets.title: Zebra Portrait
assets.creator: amyleerobinson
assets.provenance: Amy supplied the textured GLB export from her Meshy model. Public share page credits amyleerobinson and lists CC BY 4.0. Source generation labels: Smart Topology + Meshy T2 + Meshy 7 (Texture).
assets.modifications: Three embedded 2048 x 2048 JPEG textures resized to 1024 x 1024 and re-encoded at quality 90, 4:4:4. Geometry, indices and UVs preserved. Game normalizes scale/orientation and applies approximate procedural poses.
assets.reviewStatus: AI-generated prototype supplied by creator; species anatomy and procedural motion require wildlife-expert review. Not a production animation rig.
